author: Arnav
problem: Read N platform heights H. Start on platform 1 and keep moving to the next platform while it is strictly higher than the current one; print the height of the platform where you stop.
bug_description: ans starts at 0 instead of H[0], so when the first step is already blocked (or N is 1) it prints 0 instead of the first platform's height.

comments.accurate: Walks right while each next platform is higher and prints the height reached
comments.wrong_behavior: Walks right while each next platform is higher and prints the height climbed to, or 0 if no step up was possible
comments.wrong_location: Starting height handled; check the strict comparison when two neighbouring platforms are equal
